newsitem.title: USA: Mattel boosts share buyback, sees "excellent" Q4.
newsitem.headline: Mattel boosts share buyback, sees "excellent" Q4.

text.p: Toy maker Mattel Inc said on Tuesday its board had expanded a share buyback plan, and Chairman and Chief Executive John Amerman said the company was on track to report excellent fourth quarter performance.

"With our strongest 1996 new product introductions now reaching retail shelves, and our plans for aggressive advertising and promotion support, we are on track to achieve excellent fourth quarter performance," Amerman said.
Mattel said its board had expanded a share repurchase program, authorizing a buyback of 10 million shares, up from 8.75 million previously approved.
